purpose: Validate two independently frozen NLC returns before C sees their substantive content; this contract contains no page number, transcription, page side, or expected answer.

comparison.transcription_rule: Compare NFKC text after removing spacing and common punctuation; preserve both originals verbatim.
comparison.uncertain_characters_rule: Any non-empty uncertainty remains explicit and cannot be silently normalized away.
comparison.conflict_rule: Any location, chain, or normalized-transcription disagreement produces HOLD_CONFLICT; C records the discrepancy but does not overwrite either return.

next_checkpoint: Run the validator only after distinct Q and D return bytes exist and are frozen; then create a separate C cross-review receipt.
